title: Battle of Otlukbeli
text: The Battle of Otlukbeli The Battle of Otlukbeli was a pitched battle that took place on August 11, 1473, between the Ottoman army under the command of Sultan Mehmed the Conqueror and the army of the Aq Qoyunlu state led by Sultan Uzun Hasan, at the Otlukbeli location within the borders of present-day Erzincan. This military conflict, which pitted the two major Turkic-Islamic states in Anatolia against each other, resulted in a victory for the Ottoman Empire.
